about_item: [Next-Gen Bone Conduction Tech] Psier Bone conduction headphones utilize the latest Bone conduction tech and a fully enclosed cavity design, providing premium loud sound through the bone. The open-ear design keeps you aware of surroundings, making them perfect for running, cycling, hiking, and outdoor activities. With upgraded acoustic sealing that reduces sound leakage by up to 50%, you enjoy powerful audio and enhanced secure awareness.

[Feather-Light Comfort & Secure Fit] Weighing only 23g, open ear headphones feature a flexible memory-titanium frame that contours to your head for a stable. The open-ear design keeps your ear canals free for better airflow , preventing ear fatigue and protecting ear health. Enjoy hours of pressure-free listening while running, cycling, or hiking, with an adjustable strap included to fit different head sizes.

[Seamless Connectivity, Powerful Sound] These bone conduction headphones bluetooth feature next-gen Bluetooth 6.0 for instant pairing, a stable 33 ft range, and 60 ms low-latency for uninterrupted listening. Driven by large 13 mm speakers and 90 dB sensitivity, they deliver a rich, balanced sound with crisp treble and detailed mids for an immersive audio experience in any environment.

[Uninterrupted Listening Freedom] Experience the freedom of all-day audio with these open ear headphones. Get up to 10 hours of uninterrupted music or podcasts at 50% volume, perfect for your longest sessions. When it's time to power up, the stable Type-C fast charging gets you from zero to full in about 2 hours, with a massive 200-hour standby. It's power performance designed to keep you immersed in sound, not tied to an outlet.

[All-Weather Durability] Engineered to withstand intense sweat and sudden rain with an IPX5 waterproof rating, bone conduction earbuds are your durable companion for any run, cycle, or workout. They deliver clear audio and reliable protection in all conditions, letting you focus purely on your performance. (Not suitable for underwater use.)

The headphones function well during workouts and connect easily to cell phones, with one customer noting they work better than $300 earbuds. Customers consider them good value for money.
